class.name: GDLapTelemetry
class.brief_description: Container for lap telemetry data channels.
class.description: [GDLapTelemetry] represents the telemetry data recorded for a single lap or a live snapshot. Instead of discrete structural snapshots, data is organized into channels (arrays of values over time or distance), making it ideal for rendering graphs or calculating analytics in GDScript.

method.name: get_channels
method.description: Returns a dictionary containing all telemetry channels. Keys are channel names, and values are arrays of recorded data points for that lap.

method.name: get_channel_average
method.description: Calculates and returns the average value of the specified telemetry channel over the entire lap. Returns 0.0 if the channel does not exist or is empty.
